indexing: All pallet, wave, zone, team, and handling-class arrays use one-based MiniZinc indices.

pallet_count.meaning: capacity units consumed by a scheduled pallet

handling_class.meaning: class that determines wave compatibility and changeover

process_minutes.meaning: wave duration is the maximum among its members

deadline_minute.meaning: the assigned wave must finish by this value

parent.meaning: zero means no dependency; otherwise the referenced pallet is scheduled no later

wave_capacity.load: sum pallet_count for pallets assigned to the wave

zone_capacity.load: sum pallet_count for pallets assigned to the zone

team_capacity.load: sum pallet_count for pallets assigned to the team

conflict_fields.rule: A pair may both be scheduled, but its endpoints cannot share a wave.

class_min_waves.meaning: minimum occupied waves assigned to each class

class_changeover.meaning: directed setup from the preceding class to the current class; diagonal entries are initial setup

sequence_fields.occupied_wave_rule: Occupied waves form a nonempty prefix beginning with wave 1.
sequence_fields.single_class_rule: All pallets assigned to one occupied wave have the same handling_class.
sequence_fields.start_rule: Wave 1 starts after its initial setup and all member arrivals; later waves start after member arrivals and the previous finish plus directed setup.
sequence_fields.finish_rule: A wave finishes after the maximum process_minutes among its members.

team_wave_limit.meaning: maximum distinct occupied waves in which a team appears

output.selection: The final RESULT record is the optimal solution consumed by the verifier.
